chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from al-Husayn ibn Sayf, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:
I heard him saying: “When you combine the two prayers, then do not perform voluntary prayer between them.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the two prayers; the pair of obligatory salats being combined
key_terms.بَيْنَهُمَا: between them; in the interval separating the two combined prayers
key_terms.تَتَطَوَّعْ: perform voluntary prayer; offer a non-obligatory devotional salat
key_terms.جَمَعْتَ: you combined; joined two obligatory prayers together in one sequence

ai.seo_question: Can one perform a voluntary prayer between two combined obligatory salats?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the combination of two salats. It instructs that when the two prayers are combined, one should not perform a supererogatory prayer between them, indicating the continuity of the combined performance.
